description: This file defines the OAuthTokenMarkDeletedService class, which handles marking OAuth tokens as deleted based on expiration or revocation status, including database management and logging functionalities.

classes.name: OAuthTokenMarkDeletedService
classes.description: Service class responsible for marking OAuth tokens as deleted based on expiration or revocation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the process to update OAuth tokens as deleted based on configured thresholds.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Retrieves the database manager instance, throws exception if connection fails.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with specified severity, section, and message content.

methods.name: getOAuthTokenDeleteThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the threshold for deleting OAuth tokens, defaults to '-7 days' if configuration is invalid.
